site_name: Plot 24 and 26 Land off Ferry Lane
decision_conditions: The amendment to the approved application listed below is considered to be of a minor nature and acceptable in its own right and not require resubmission of a fresh planning application.
The following amendment is deemed to be accepted:
- Amendment to allow for works to be in two phases and to amend the wording of conditions 13, 14 and 16 and a newly imposed condition as follows:
Prior to the commencement of Phase 2 of the development hereby approved, the developer or contractor must be signed up to the Non Road Mobile Machinery (NRMM) register.
a)The development site must be entered onto the register alongside all the NRMM equipment details.
b)The register must be kept up-to-date for the duration of the construction of  development.

c)All NRMM used during the course of the development that is within the scope of the Greater London Authority 'Control of Dust and Emissions during Construction and Demolition' Supplementary Planning Guidance (SPG) dated July 2014, or
This development is a 'phased planning permission' for the purposes of the CIL Regulations (2010) as amended (Reg 2(1)).
The applicant is advised that this amendment relates solely to the item detailed above and shown on drawing number and documents:
31243-PL-211E Site Layout Plan Phase -1 Digging of Trench to Contain Foundations for Permitted New Electricity Substation
31243-PL-211F Site Layout Plan Phase 2- Remainder of Development following Phase
Supporting Statement - covering letter, dated 19th March 2026
and not to any other deviation from the approved drawings.
description: Application for a non-material amendment to planning permission Ref:P1492.21 dated 18/05/2023 to allow for works to be in two phases (Application for full planning permission for two new industrial units providing 6,700 sqm GEA of flexible use (E(g)(iii) / B2 / B8) with parking, landscaping and associated works at Plot 24 and 26, Ferry Lane)
